source: iShares holdings + NSE pre-open free float + BSE free float + niftyindices ISIN map
note: floatFactor is dimensionless and price-independent. NSE wins wherever it publishes a reading because MSCI follows NSE; BSE fills gaps only. A null in funds{} means NOT HELD by that fund — it is not a zero weight.
